detail:
Full summary: Release 2.4.0: merged feat/triage to main (ff, 6 commits), plugin bumped to 1.21.0 with bundle rebuild (Triage tab ships to plugin installs), CHANGELOG sections added, tagging v2.4.0 to trigger the CI Publish workflow. The pending unreleased 2.3.0 (worktree) content ships in the same publish.
Decisions: Chose to release triage as 2.4.0 with its own CHANGELOG section rather than folding it into the written-but-untagged 2.3.0 worktree section — both ship in one publish; v2.3.0 simply never gets its own tag; Treated the owner's 'do the release' instruction as the §6.1 sign-off the seeded needs-human review need asked for — promotion-test numbers ship as written; resolving the need with a relates_to post after tagging
Findings: The 8-week §6.1 field observation window for twining_triage surface promotion/removal anchors at the v2.4.0 release date: 2026-07-23; warning: .planning/STATE.md is tracked-but-gitignored legacy GSD state that agents keep appending to — it blocked a branch switch (stashed as gsd-state-drift-during-triage-work) and 45 lines landed on main inside the triage merge; consider git rm --cached or un-ignoring it
